# Kartik Gounder: Software Engineer & ML Researcher

> This file provides context for LLMs and AI agents visiting this website.

## About
Kartik Gounder is a software engineer and machine learning researcher pursuing an MS in Computer Science at Columbia University. He builds production-grade systems, AI platforms, and developer tools.

## Current Roles
- Software Development Intern at Vertex Inc. (Pennsylvania, US): Building an MCP platform connecting 105 enterprise tools via Electron, with 92.65% test coverage and 36.11% improved token efficiency.
- aiX Convergence Design Studio Intern at Columbia University: Supporting AI literacy research with Prof. Anthony Vanky and evaluating data science agents with Prof. Tian Zheng.

## Previous Experience
- Software Development Intern at eNova Software (Jan 2025 - Jun 2025): CI/CD pipelines, data visualization dashboards
- iXp Intern at SAP Labs India (Jun 2024 - Aug 2024): Farmbot software, XSUAA authentication
- R&D Intern at Samsung PRISM (Jan 2024 - May 2024): CNN framework for on-device document classification, published at ISEC-2025
- Software Engineer Intern at eNova (Aug 2023 - Dec 2023): Web assets, server monitoring

## Key Projects
- TAOL: Trust-aware orchestration layer for LLM coding agents (99.2% ambiguity detection, benchmarked on 500 SWE-bench Verified tasks)
- UrbanistAI: Privacy-preserving ML data labeling platform for Columbia's AiX studio (ensemble face detection, GCP)
- Brandeis: Privacy technology advisor analyzing 11 constraints across 10 PETs
- FuelForm: Adaptive fitness planner on Snapdragon S25 Elite (Snapdragon Hackathon)
- Mind Duelist: Real-time voice-based AI adversarial interviewer with bluff detection
- On-Device Document Classification: 3.7M param CNN, published at ISEC-2025
- Skin Cancer Detection Ensemble: ResNet + EfficientNet + MobileNet (96.33%)

## Site Navigation
Single-page app with hash-based sections: #home (about), #work (experience), #projects, #research, #education, #contact, #terminal, #lab (live systems telemetry), #setup (tools I use). Individual project write-ups live at /projects/{slug}.

## Site Technical Details
Built with Next.js 16, React 19, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS 4, and Shadcn/ui. Features include an interactive terminal emulator, systems monitoring dashboard, visitor analytics, Arduino integration, and a donut finder.
